text: ∀x (ElectronicDevice(x) ∧ DisplaysTime(x) ∧ ReceivesRadioSignalsForAccurateTimekeeping(x) ∧ PoweredByBattery(x) → RadioControlledClock(x)) ::: An electronic device that displays the time, receives radio signals for accurate timekeeping, and is powered by a battery is a radio-controlled clock.
